bio.text: Jeff Crank was elected in 2024 to represent Colorado's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
A native of southern Colorado, he graduated from Colorado State University with a degree in political science and worked for Rep. Joel Hefley in Washington from 1991 to 1998.
He later served as Vice President and then Senior Vice President of the Colorado Springs Chamber of Commerce and as Chief Operating Officer of Americans for Prosperity.
